title: Compromised NPM package to GitHub OIDC and AWS administrator pivot
confirmed_facts: Google Cloud described a 2025 case where a compromised NPM package stole a developer GitHub token.
The actor abused GitHub-to-AWS OIDC trust and an overly permissive CloudFormation role to create an administrator role.
Google Cloud reported S3 access, production resource termination, key decryption, and repository exposure within the attack chain.
inferences: Short-lived OIDC credentials are not sufficient when subject conditions and the assumable cloud role permit creation of broader IAM authority.
trust_boundaries: GitHub workflow identity to AWS STS
deployment role to IAM and production resources
control_hypotheses: OIDC trust must bind exact repository, workflow, ref, environment, and audience rather than trusting an organization broadly.
Deployment roles must not create or pass roles outside a reviewed boundary.
The composition control should fail when a workflow can alter the identity policy that authorizes itself.

regression.mutation: Add a broadly trusted GitHub OIDC subject and iam:PassRole or CloudFormation IAM capability with no boundary.
